decision.explanation: The provided documents contain contradictory assertions regarding Neil O'Neill's spouse. Document 1 (D1S1, D1S3, D1S17) explicitly identifies 'Frances Molyneux' as his wife, citing a marriage settlement and letters. Document 2 (D2S10, D2S13) explicitly identifies 'Robert Dunbar of Burgie' as his spouse, citing church records and correspondence. Per the instruction to keep supported alternate referents rather than selecting one familiar winner, both distinct namesakes/claims are included as valid answers derived from the respective source segments.
